item.title: Alibaba Cloud Apsara Supernode Stack Pairs Zhenwu V900 With ICN, Pangu NIC and Zhenyue SSD

item.title: T-Head Maps Yitian 720 and 730 Server CPUs for 2027; Yitian 750 to ICN-Link Zhenwu
item.description: At Apsara 2026, T-Head outlined Yitian 720 and 730 server CPUs for 2027 and a later Yitian 750 that adds ICN-link direct attach to Zhenwu AI accelerators—CPU roadmap, not a Zhenwu V900 chip unveil.

item.title: Huawei Unveils Peerium Architecture: Nested BSP for Million-Processor Scale
item.description: Huawei's Peerium Computing Architecture uses Nested BSP, unified memory addressing and UnifiedBus peer interconnect so up to about one million processors can operate as one computer, extending—not overthrowing—von Neumann single-machine design.
